Title: Check Point PHP2Shell TSGA - ipv4
Description: Attacker IP that scanned and exploited Check Point Mobile Access portals with PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) from 30 October 2026, first against Israeli organisations. Source: Check Point Research – PHP2Shell Exploitation on Check Point Gateway https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/php2shell-exploitation-on-check-point-gateway/
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and search 90 days of firewall, VPN and gateway logs for connections.

Title: Check Point PHP2Shell TSGA - sha256
Description: PHP webshell written as zz*.tpl into the Mobile Access login templates directory; the expanded version needs the key zz2026 and runs commands, PHP code and uploads to /tmp/.up.tpl. Source: Check Point Research – PHP2Shell Exploitation on Check Point Gateway https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/php2shell-exploitation-on-check-point-gateway/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
